records.subject: A quick nudge about your Wrenfield workspace
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Following up to see how things are going. If Wrenfield isn't the right fit, that's useful to know too -- either way I'd appreciate a reply.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

It's been a few days -- how's the setup going on your end? If you'd like a short walkthrough call, I'm happy to set one up.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Quartz Partners set up
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *Quartz Partners* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Kickoff held [calendar:7d3d4151] shows intent, but 6 days in there's no project, no invite, and no reply to welcome [email:69844f70] or check-in [email:ae23453e]. Silence after two Wrenfield emails plus zero tickets suggests low self-serve momentum; 8 days remain, so some chance remains.

draft.subject: Picking up where our kickoff left off
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks again for making time for the kickoff last week. Since then I haven't wanted to pile on, but I do want to make sure Quartz Partners gets moving before things get busy.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting that first project in place is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through that first project with you live and answer anything that came up after kickoff.

Best,
Priya
